newsitem.title: USA: Star refinery fire in Louisiana under control.
newsitem.headline: Star refinery fire in Louisiana under control.

text.p: A fire at Star Enterprise's Convent, Louisiana, oil refinery was under control but still burning Wednesday night, a company spokesman said.
Production at the 225,000 bpd facility, Star's second largest in the United States, was reduced by 20 percent, spokesman Pierre DeGruy told Reuters.
The cause of the blaze, which shot flames 75 feet into the air, was not known and under investigation, DeGruy said. No deaths or injuries were reported.
DeGruy said the H-oil unit, which processes heavy crude into fuel oil and diesel, caught fire about 6 p.m. (CST). The unit processes 35,000 bpd.
Lines feeding the unit were shut down, and firefighters were allowing the remaining fuel to burn off, he said.
Star is a joint venture of Texaco Inc and Saudi Refinery Inc.
